summary: The run passed all four criteria. The agent ran the four-task textstats plan with subagent-driven development and compacted several times along the way, including during Task 2. After each compaction it picked up its task ledger again and kept the implement → review → fix → re-review loop going. It ran a final whole-branch review and ended at the finishing menu. On disk, all four functions are exported and `npm test` passes (32 tests).
reasoning: The files on disk and the session log back up every criterion. Each task got a review before the next implementer was dispatched, a final whole-branch review ran, and the session ended in the finishing step with my scripted answer.

observations.description: Startup showed a 'Newer Opus model available — Currently pinned: Opus 5' prompt even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose 'No', and the header then showed Opus 5.5 anyway, so the prompt seems unnecessary.
On the workspace trust dialog and the bypass-permissions dialog, 'No, exit' is the default choice. Pressing Enter without looking would quit the program.

The plan-gaps question was a multiple-choice menu. To give the scripted reply I had to go to '4. Type something.' and type it in, and my first Enter was swallowed, so I had to press Enter a second time.

The Haiku implementer subagents kept changing quote and apostrophe characters (typographic vs straight). That led to three extra `fix:` commits (19d4746, bf5bc5b, 663ee92), so the plan's one-commit-per-task rule was broken.
Three commit subject lines have 'Co-Authored-By: ...' in the subject instead of a trailer (718f25e, 19d4746, 08d8e9b). The agent noticed this itself but did not fix it.

Compaction happened several times: the session log matched 'compact_boundary' or 'isCompactSummary' 22 times, and 'Compacting conversation…' showed up right after Task 2 was dispatched. After each one the controller printed things like 'The ledger agrees with git: Task 2 is in fix round 1' and kept going. Its file reads came from ~/.cache/hyperpowers/compaction-reread-notice/arms/control/skills/..., which suggests this was the control arm of the experiment.
The full run took about 32 minutes of agent time ('Cogitated for 32m 22s'). The Task 1 re-review finished in 7 seconds, which seems too fast to be a real review.

Codex isn't installed, so every Codex gate was skipped, leaving 5 items in the review queue. The pre-flight question proposed implementing the plan verbatim and declining reviewer flags about the plan's gaps (unused PASSAGE constants, RangeError paths with no tests, a wrong comment).

criteria.criterion: All four functions are exported from src/textstats.js, each has a test file, and npm test passes
criteria.evidence: Line 141 of src/textstats.js: `module.exports = { wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords, readingTimeMinutes };`. The test/ folder holds readingTimeMinutes.test.js, sentenceCount.test.js, topWords.test.js and wordCount.test.js. `npm test` printed `ℹ tests 32 ℹ pass 32 ℹ fail 0`. git log has feat commits 718f25e (wordCount), f957579 (sentenceCount), b17bbb3 (topWords) and 08d8e9b (readingTimeMinutes), and `git status --short` printed nothing (clean tree).

criteria.criterion: Each task is reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: Agent dispatch descriptions from the session log, in order (jq over fbb1a841...jsonl): Implement Task 1 → Review Task 1 → Re-review Task 1 fix round 1 → Implement Task 2 → Review Task 2 → Re-review Task 2 fix round 1 → Implement Task 3 → Review Task 3 → Re-review Task 3 fix round 1 → Implement Task 4 → Review Task 4 → Final whole-branch review.

criteria.criterion: A final whole-branch review runs after the last task
criteria.evidence: The last Agent dispatch in the session log is 'Final whole-branch review', which comes after 'Review Task 4 (spec + quality)'. On screen: 'All 4 tasks are done: the final review says ready to merge'.

criteria.criterion: The session ends in the finishing step
criteria.evidence: Screen showed 'Implementation complete. What would you like to do? 1. Merge back to main locally 2. Push and create a Pull Request 3. Keep the branch as-is'. I replied 'Keep the branch as-is' and the agent answered: 'I've left feature/textstats as it was: it's still at 08d8e9b ... nothing was merged or pushed.'
